facts.text: Nineteen casitas each have a private terrace and plunge pool.
facts.excerpt: 19 Casitas with private terrace and plunge pool

facts.text: The Presidential Casita has a private garden and plunge pool.
facts.excerpt: 1 Presidential Casita with private garden and plunge pool

facts.text: The casitas have wood-burning fireplaces, heated laja-stone floors and plunge pools on the private terraces.
facts.excerpt: wood-burning fireplaces, heated laja-stone floors, and piping-hot plunge pools on the private terraces

facts.text: Staff slip a woolen hot water bottle between the bedsheets in the evening.
facts.excerpt: Staff slip a woolen hot water bottle between the bedsheets in the evening.

facts.text: The restaurant is Curiña, serving contemporary Peruvian cuisine.
The hotel has a cocktail bar called Puccq'io.

facts.excerpt: Experience next-level rejuvenation in the Colca Valley at Samay Spa.

facts.text: The hotel has an outdoor heated swimming pool.
Llamas and alpacas live on the property.
The hotel has a cultivated vegetable garden.
The property has a restored on-site chapel.
The hotel is in a remote, quiet location in the Colca Valley.
facts.excerpt: Remote, quiet location in Colca Valley

facts.text: Guests can set off before dawn to see Andean condors rising on thermal winds above the Colca Canyon.
facts.excerpt: set off before dawn and witness the majesty of the Andean condor, rising on thermal winds

facts.text: Activities include hiking trails, horseback tours and birdwatching.
facts.excerpt: Hiking trails, horseback tours and birdwatching

facts.text: The Colca Valley has been home to pre-Inca inhabitants since 600 AD, including the Collagua and Cabana tribes.
facts.excerpt: It has been home to pre-Inca inhabitants since 600 AD, including the Collagua and Cabana tribes.

facts.text: Nights can be chilly at 9,800 feet above sea level.
facts.excerpt: Nights can be chilly at 9,800 feet above sea level

facts.text: The hotel is a three-hour drive from the nearest airport, in Arequipa.
